question: By what inherent power are the expansive words of the lords of speech restrained?
premises: The speaker claims to bring restraint.
The restrained objects are the spread-out words.
Those words belong to the lords of speech.
inference: The speaker inherently subdues the expansive speech of authoritative teachers.
uncertainties: The identity of the lords of speech is not specified.
plain_english: By nature I bring under restraint those spread-out words of the lords of speech.
